verification.placementRule: Count only root-level paragraphs within the numbered section, including image paragraphs and excluding blockquote paragraphs. A code fence is not a paragraph.

changes: Replaced the generic completeness decision tree with three concrete saveReport contract/implementation states, retaining the ID and asset URLs.
A documents the caller's parent-directory obligation and has the caller create it before write; B deletes the condition but leaves write unchanged, so a direct missing-directory call still fails.
C moves ensureParent before write inside the module, removing the caller's directory-creation obligation while retaining the same path/text result for the illustrated successful scenario.
Separated caller obligations from internal work with a boundary and explicitly grouped A/B as identical implementations.
Retained the author's shallow-method criterion and warned that interface simplicity alone does not establish depth.
records.responseToReview: The reader can now inspect the unchanged obligation and implementation in B and the actual responsibility transfer in C, instead of accepting category labels or a word-count verdict.
records.teachingInvention: saveReport, ensureParent and write are editorial pseudocode. The common starting state lacks a parent directory; directory creation and writing are assumed able to succeed.
limits: The illustrated preservation concerns saving the same text at the same path in the stated success case.
No equivalence of permission failures, races, partial writes or all other observable effects is asserted.
Box area, comment length and step count are not depth measurements.
